care.title: Care journey
care.intro: Four connected stages for evidence, questions, actions and rechecking. This is an interactive navigation guide, not a persisted medical episode.
care.detail_0: Gather reported symptoms and source-backed measurements. Open the symptom interview or Monitoring without forcing healthy users to report symptoms.
care.detail_1: Review provenance and approved knowledge. Do not treat unreviewed legacy severity labels as a clinical diagnosis or clearance.
care.detail_2: Authorized humans must confirm performed actions. An AI suggestion cannot mark a treatment as completed.
care.detail_3: Review new measurements or reports after an action. Without a Care API, this app does not claim that a recheck was stored.
care.not_persistent: No Server Care-episode persistence API is available yet. These buttons navigate to actual views; selecting a stage does not write clinical records.

demo.portal.summary: NASA source explorer + 540-day fictional patient demo
demo.hero.title: A mission with real records.
demo.hero.subtitle: Explore biomedical indicators NASA reported for Mercury-Atlas 7 (1962). Every value has a source table and page.
demo.intro.warning: THIS IS NOT LIVE ASTRONAUT TELEMETRY. ECG waveforms, SpO₂, sleep, mood, serum glucose and personal radiation dose are unavailable in this file. No values are invented.
demo.intro.notchallenge: NASA Space Apps does not provide one public unified all-health-indicators dataset. These values come from a public NASA document, not a challenge-specific continuous stream. OSDR-569/575 are separate Inspiration4 studies; their measurement files are not bundled in this replay.
demo.replay.title: Data journey
demo.replay.lead: Select a group and timepoint to see NASA's published figures. This replays an archive, not a live monitor.
demo.replay.notice: NASA historical data — not a present-day health assessment, not added to patient records and not used to infer clinical risk.
demo.replay.errorSource: Source file/schema validation failed — replay disabled
demo.replay.version: Source: NASA MA-7, report published 15 June 1962
demo.intro.osdrWarning: Separate NASA research sources; OSD-569/575 measurements have not been merged into the MA-7 replay.
demo.official.title: OFFICIAL CHALLENGE RESOURCES
demo.official.description: The challenge lists 3 NASA HRP sources and 2 CSA sources. NASA HRP contextualizes five hazards and the limits of interpreting indicators; it does not supply a continuous personal telemetry stream.
demo.official.five: Five hazards: radiation; isolation; distance from Earth; altered gravity; closed environments.
demo.official.explain: NASA's 1962 MA-7 report supplies real measurements, but it is a supplementary source, not one of the five listed challenge links. This archive is not proof of continuous health monitoring.
care.intake.translation_note: Draft English search terminology; not clinically reviewed. The interview uses the original Vietnamese symptom identity.
